comment: Skill registry. mandatory skills are always synced and cannot be deselected. recommend_for keys match icm-scaffold archetypes (content, client, ops, software). Local skills are folders in this repo; external skills add a source: {repo, path, ref} where ref is a FULL COMMIT SHA (never a branch or tag - supply chain rule). Review any external SKILL.md before first registration: installing a skill imports its author's beliefs along with its instructions.

icm-sync.description: Keeps IDENTITY.md and CONTEXT.md routing accurate as the workspace evolves

icm-context-scaffold.description: Generates missing CONTEXT.md files as folders grow

skills-manager.description: Updates skills from the library, adds new ones (local or external) on demand

icm-scaffold.description: The workspace factory itself; only for workspaces that will scaffold other workspaces

humanizer.description: Rewrites AI-sounding prose against Wikipedia's Signs of AI writing: keeps every claim, invents nothing, matches the writer's voice. Note: our house no-dash rule outranks its sample-following on em dashes
